scope: Frozen disabled production preflight/Host, state/check-in witnesses, private restore verifier and read-only retained-transaction inspector. Separate numerical qualification runner is excluded.

validation.metadata_model_alias_check: Only is_symlink metadata on existing manifest keys: all9 model artifact paths are direct cached-snapshot links. No model weight content read.

accepted_findings: Full immutable source/package/model closure, original manifest/RECORD verification and original interpreter family are required; sparse caller inventories cannot replace them. Loaded historical bytes remain explicitly reviewed provenance, not inferred from current disk.

Large live logs use at most 1 MiB streaming prefix hashing and bounded captured tails. Append tolerance is limited to later bytes; rotation/truncation/prefix rewrite or incomplete records refuses. Idle/empty anchors establish complete windows only; provider drain/check-in remains the actual admission barrier.

Check-in verification requires complete successful generation/QoS/push pairs before reservoir stop. Final-save verification reconciles exact active handles, and stopped backup must contain each fresh NPZ and thermostat sidecar plus all historical files.

Private restore runs synchronous actual restore_all only on independent copies, with exact repaired entrypoint/five original dependencies, original packages/interpreters and derived config. Complete 22 stored-field, history, thermostat and elapsed-time semantics are required; no production wrapper is introduced.

Provider pin changes only the sole --model value to the reviewed cached snapshot; process framework argv and launch alias remain distinct. Original plist is retained. Atomic pin intent precedes replacement and bootstrap intent binds both applied and original rollback hashes. Failed replacement/bootstrap tests preserve exact evidence.
Cooperative signal intent now records durable wall_time_ns equal to final-file freshness boundary before SIGTERM. Legacy missing boundary remains unresolved.

Recovery inspector accepts only qualified holder Python family, validates owner/plan/controller chain/ordered host records and referenced witnesses, and detects record-set growth/absent-file appearance. Narrow model/interpreter direct aliases bind link and target identities; private records remain canonical/nofollow.

An intent without result remains unresolved despite current bytes/PID appearing successful. Uncertain held removal does not clear potentially pending override. Read-only IO allowlist excludes service probes, sudo and mutations; every resume/retry/recovery-authority flag is unconditionally false.

Metadata helper reads bounded archive headers/scalars and sidecars with individual stable-read guards and no numerical imports. Its 102 observed paths (99 NumPy, 3 lsm_shadow) are a read-only planning observation, not a cross-file snapshot or restore acceptance.
explicit_remaining_execution_blockers: Do not execute or qualify against frozen production-candidate-01 verifier e363cc11: source-origin check ordering deterministically rejects fresh real execution. A separate versioned fix/new tests/review and qualifier rebinding are required first. Preserve v1 sources and all earlier receipts unchanged.
Current host settling/memory gate must pass before any numerical workload; no gate is relaxed by this review.

Complete frozen real-service 14-case matrix and separately qualify the NEW restore_verifier under actual installed original runtime on private 192-node NumPy AND lsm_shadow fixtures, with semantic positive and corruption/drift negative controls. Matrix-only 102 NumPy coverage cannot qualify 3 LSM histories. Later stopped-production backup verification is a second actual check, not its first.
Integrate and review the finite external private restore runner. This review does not cover the separate restore-qualification-01 runner being authored.
Prepare exact current runtime-alignment/source/model/package/fixture evidence and revalidate protected identities. No operational production preparation has been accepted or captured by this review.

Review narrow controller changes for exact production admission, pinned provider_settings invariant transition, and explicitly pinned replacement argv while preserving old drain identity. REQUIRED_INPUTS is already a subset check: additive provider_restart_settings needs no key-schema relaxation.

Read-only inspector is not a resumable Host or recovery executor. Qualify exact-phase human-reviewed recovery/rollback decisions before enabling production, including uncertain override/signal/install/bootstrap outcomes. Never automatically rearm, repeat signal, replay bootstrap or roll back runtime state.

Keep both existing blocks until that review: PRODUCTION_EXECUTION_ENABLED=False and fixture-only controller admission. Source changes require new hash-bound tests/review and relevant fixture/equivalence evidence.
limits: Inspector evidence_valid/exit0 means internally consistent parsed evidence only; unresolved fields and unconditional no-authority flags remain decisive. It does not requalify numerical witnesses, log prefix semantics, admission state or loaded source.
Contiguous host records and controller hash chain cannot detect a fully rewritten self-consistent history or missing unanchored tail. No authenticated history claim is made.

Private actual restore plus identical inputs/implementation and complete production startup logs provides deterministic-path inference, not direct in-process production-memory equality. Unstored LSM internal trajectories are not claimed preserved.
The policy AST receipt binds the preflight bytes tested at that earlier step; the final preflight has its own 25-test frozen receipt. It is not represented as an identical whole-file hash.
No live source, service, state, packages, controller pause, signal, launchd operation or numerical workload was changed or executed in this review.

The77 fake tests did not exercise real constructor/import order. Their passing receipts remain accurate but are insufficient for actual numerical qualification; this specific gap is now recorded and blocks v1 execution.
